name: The Wagering of Wrath
source:
Abandoned by her mother and her latter foster parents, Wera no longer has anyone to rely on, nor a reason to see tomorrow. She has grown to harbor bitter resentment and unbridled anger towards life. A life lacking in purpose and meaning is a life not worth living.

Wanting nothing more than death, Wera is given a chance to rethink her decision when an angel wagers that she’d change her mind is just 10 days. At first, Wera is convinced that nothing will change, but a new classmate, a beloved person from her past and a persistent neighbour unexpectedly enters her life and now, Wera is not so sure anymore…

[From [url=http://sevensalvations.wordpress.com/wrath/]official site[/url]]
translation:
被母亲和后来的养父母抛弃后，薇拉不再有可以依靠的人，也找不到活到明天的理由。她逐渐对生活积累起苦涩的怨恨与无法遏制的愤怒。没有目标和意义的人生，不值得继续下去。

薇拉一心只想死去，但当天使赌她会在10天内改变主意时，她获得了重新考虑的机会。起初，薇拉确信一切都不会改变，可一名新同学、过去深爱的人，以及一位执着的邻居意外地进入了她的生活。现在，薇拉不再那么确定了……
